purpose: identify the foreground PID recorded in both historical exit-timeout failure observations (observed-08, native-focus-3)
query: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = 4212" | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CreationDate, CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
note: run on 2026-09-09 to back the report's QQ.exe claim; a match of CreationDate with the 2026-09-07 12:58 timestamp quoted at 01:40 would confirm the process never restarted between then and now
